title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Giving Full Play to the Adjudicative Functions to Provide Judicial Services and Safeguards for Promoting Ecological Civilization Construction and Green Development
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Giving Full Play to the Functions of Adjudication to Provide Judicial Services and Guarantees for Promoting the Construction of Ecological Civilization and Green Development

Fa Fa [2016] No. 12

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Third, Fourth, and Fifth Plenary Sessions of the 18th Central Committee, promote the comprehensive implementation of the Outline of the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development, give full play to the adjudication functions of the people's courts, and provide fair and efficient judicial services and guarantees for accelerating the construction of ecological civilization and green development, the following opinions are formulated.

I. Accurately Grasp the Basic Concepts and Overall Requirements for the People's Courts to Serve and Guarantee the Construction of Ecological Civilization and Green Development

1. Fully understand the important significance of serving and guaranteeing the construction of ecological civilization and green development under the new situation. Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Party Central Committee has placed the construction of ecological civilization on a more important strategic position. Following the issuance of the two programmatic documents, the "Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Ecological Civilization" and the "Overall Plan for the Reform of the Ecological Civilization System," the Fifth Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee and the Outline of the 13th Five-Year Plan established the new development concepts of innovation, coordination, greenness, openness, and sharing, proposed the goal of overall improvement in ecological and environmental quality, and made a series of major decisions and deployments, pointing out the direction, goals, and paths for the rule of law in ecological civilization. Environmental and resource adjudication is an important link in the national environmental governance system and plays a significant role in the construction of ecological civilization and green development. People's courts at all levels must deeply study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's new concepts, new ideas, and new assertions on strengthening the construction of ecological civilization and green development, accurately grasp the tasks and objectives of serving and guaranteeing the construction of ecological civilization and green development, and give full play to the functions of environmental and resource adjudication in relieving environmental rights, restricting public power, settling disputes, and forming public policies, so as to continuously improve the quality of the ecological environment, promote sustainable economic and social development, and safeguard environmental justice and intergenerational equity.

2. Promote environmental and resource adjudication in a coordinated manner based on the new development concepts. People's courts at all levels must deeply implement the new development concepts and take the concept of green development as the guiding principle for environmental and resource adjudication. Strictly implement the environmental and resource legal system, take differentiated measures based on the functional zoning system, and properly handle the relationship between environmental protection and economic development. Protect the environmental rights of the people in accordance with the law, coordinate public environmental interests and individual interests, and safeguard the rights of the people to survive and develop in a healthy, comfortable, and beautiful environment. Increase the application of the precautionary principle, timely adopt measures for preservation of acts and advance enforcement in accordance with the law to prevent the occurrence and expansion of environmental damage. Implement a damage relief system centered on ecological and environmental restoration, comprehensively apply criminal, civil, and administrative responsibilities, and maximize the restoration of the ecological environment. Adhere to the combination of professional adjudication and public participation, fully implement the participation of people's assessors in case trials, increase judicial openness and publicity, and guide the public to orderly participate in environmental governance.

3. Strive to enhance the capacity and level of environmental and resource adjudication in serving and guaranteeing. People's courts at all levels must closely focus on the work goal of "striving to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," firmly adhere to the main line of justice for the people and fair justice, effectively implement the basic state policy of resource conservation and environmental protection, take modern environmental judicial concepts as the guide, innovate systems and mechanisms, explore adjudication rules, strengthen theoretical research, build professional teams, further promote the specialization of environmental and resource adjudication, and continuously improve the capacity and level of serving and guaranteeing the construction of ecological civilization and green development. Through judicial judgments, vigorously promote the core socialist values, implement the strictest systems of source protection, damage compensation, and accountability, enhance the environmental awareness of natural persons, legal persons, and other organizations, promote green development, and build a Beautiful China.

II. Adjudicate Cases Related to Environmental Pollution Prevention and Ecological Protection in Accordance with the Law, and Effectively Safeguard the Environmental Rights and Interests of the People

4. Adjudicate cases related to air pollution prevention and control in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts that cause serious air pollution by discharging pollutants in violation of pollutant discharge standards in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate administrative cases related to air pollution prevention and control, supervise and guarantee that government departments fully perform their duties of source control and whole-process governance, and effectively prevent and control industrial pollution, motor vehicle and ship pollution, fugitive dust pollution, agricultural pollution, and other pollution. Properly adjudicate civil and commercial cases related to air pollution prevention and control, give full play to the regulatory role of market mechanisms, guarantee the healthy development of the air environment service industry, and promote the integrated operation of investment, construction, and operation of pollution control facilities.

5. Adjudicate cases related to water pollution prevention and control in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts that cause serious water pollution by discharging prohibited pollutants such as oil, acid and alkaline liquids, highly toxic waste liquids, and radioactive solid wastes into water bodies, or by discharging wastewater exceeding discharge standards in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from the closure, relocation, or renovation of enterprises that seriously pollute water bodies such as papermaking, printing and dyeing, and chemical industries, as well as cases arising from the collection of fees such as sewage treatment fees, pollutant discharge fees, and water resource fees, to promote enterprises to meet discharge standards or exit in accordance with the law, and implement environmental tax and fee policies in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate disputes over financial leasing of environmental protection equipment, as well as disputes over pledge financing guarantees of rights such as equity, project income rights, franchise rights, and emission rights, to encourage social capital investment in water environmental protection and promote diverse financing for water pollution prevention and control.

6. Adjudicate cases related to soil pollution prevention and control in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts that cause serious soil pollution, such as illegal discharge of toxic and hazardous pollutants, illegal storage of hazardous chemicals, and illegal disposal of hazardous waste in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from the dismantling of pollution facilities for non-ferrous metal smelting, petroleum processing, coking, and leather processing, as well as the disposal of industrial waste, and the recycling and storage of discarded agricultural film, to ensure the prevention of soil pollution at the source. Properly adjudicate civil and commercial cases related to soil pollution prevention and control, fully consider the complex historical causes of soil pollution and the long repair cycle and high cost, explore the determination rules for the scope of civil liability subjects, causation, and remediation standards for soil pollution, increase the accountability for soil pollution, and safeguard food safety, living environmental safety, and sustainable agricultural development.

7. Adjudicate cases related to marine ecological environment protection in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts that illegally discharge various pollutants into the ocean and cause serious damage to the marine ecological environment by destroying mangroves, tidal flats, coral reefs, etc. in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from approvals for the introduction of marine animal and plant species, island resource development, construction of mariculture farms, and construction of marine and coastal projects, as well as tort dispute cases arising from marine pollution and ecological damage. Properly adjudicate lawsuits filed on behalf of the state by marine environmental supervision and administration departments against acts that cause significant losses to the marine ecology, marine fishery resources, and marine protected areas, to prevent marine environmental pollution and protect marine biodiversity.

8. Adjudicate cases related to ecological environmental protection in key regions in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts that seriously damage the ecological environment in key regions such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and the Sanjiangyuan area in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from the construction of national parks and forest parks, and the implementation of unified environmental access and exit mechanisms, to ensure that key regions achieve the important goal of expanding environmental capacity and ecological space. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from the construction of the Yangtze River shelterbelt system, the control of soil erosion and rocky desertification in karst areas, and the ecological protection and restoration of river and lake wetlands, to ensure the smooth implementation of major ecological restoration projects in the Yangtze River basin. Focus on strengthening the principal responsibility of polluters, ensure the construction of a joint prevention and control mechanism for pollution, and promote the continuous improvement of environmental quality in key regions.

9. Adjudicate other cases related to pollution prevention and ecological protection in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts such as producing and discharging pollutants, smuggling waste, and illegally hunting and killing rare and endangered wild animals that seriously pollute the environment and damage the ecology, and punish criminal acts of negligence and dereliction of duty in environmental supervision in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate administrative cases related to environmental impact assessment, pollutant discharge permits, fallow and rotational grazing, and closure and protection of desertified land, promote the reform of "one-certificate" management of pollutant discharge permits, and implement the target responsibility system for environmental protection. Properly adjudicate civil damage compensation cases caused by various types of environmental pollution and ecological damage, coordinate conflicts between public environmental interests and individual interests, and achieve the organic unity of relief for the rights of the parties and the protection of the ecological environment.

III. Adjudicate Cases Related to the Development and Utilization of Natural Resources in Accordance with the Law, and Ensure the Safety of Natural Resources and the Ecological Environment

10. Adjudicate cases related to land resources in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts such as illegal occupation of basic farmland, agricultural land, and forestland in accordance with the law, and strictly adhere to the ecological red line. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from land rights confirmation and real estate expropriation during industrialization and urbanization, implement the functional zoning plan in accordance with the law, reasonably control the space and intensity of national land development, and promote the construction of new, people-oriented, green, and low-carbon cities and towns. Properly adjudicate civil and commercial cases related to land transfer, encourage innovation in rural land transfer forms in accordance with the law, ensure the smooth progress of various reform pilot projects such as the mortgage of rural land management rights, and promote the establishment of a unified urban and rural construction land market.

11. Adjudicate cases related to mineral resources in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts such as illegal mining and destructive mining in accordance with the law, and ensure the safety of national mineral resources. Properly adjudicate administrative cases involving the approval and issuance of mining rights certificates, and ensure the intensive utilization and orderly development of mineral resources. Properly adjudicate civil and commercial cases involving mining rights, accurately distinguish the boundaries between civil and commercial adjudication and administrative supervision, determine the validity of contracts for the assignment, transfer, lease, contracting, and mortgage of mining rights in accordance with the law, and properly handle disputes arising from cross-border exploration and mining.

12. Adjudicate cases related to forestry resources in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts such as illegal logging and indiscriminate logging in accordance with the law, and ensure the safety of national forestry resources. Properly adjudicate administrative cases arising from the registration and issuance of forest rights certificates, forestland reclamation, and changes in forestland use, and ensure the smooth progress of forest rights reform. Pay attention to the frequent separation of forestland ownership, forestland use rights, tree ownership, and tree use rights, distinguish conflicts of rights arising from historical, policy, village rules, or other reasons, adhere to the unity of respecting the autonomy of forest rights holders and respecting the determination of administrative agencies, and properly handle various disputes arising from forest rights confirmation and forest rights transfer.

13. Adjudicate other cases related to resources in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate cases involving ownership, contracts, and torts in the development and utilization of resources such as grasslands, rivers, lakes, tidal flats, and oceans, and punish related criminal acts in accordance with the law. Focus on ensuring that the rational development and utilization of resources are coordinated with resource conservation and environmental protection, especially when adjudicating cases involving the development and utilization of natural resources in key ecological function areas, ecologically sensitive and fragile areas, as well as nature reserves and scenic spots, comprehensively consider the protection of the ecological environment and natural resources as an important factor in the judgment.

IV. Actively Explore Judicial Measures to Address Climate Change and Promote the Construction of a National Climate Change Response Governance System

14. Adjudicate cases related to carbon emissions in accordance with the law. Deeply study the legal issues in carbon emissions trading, properly adjudicate carbon emissions trading disputes, and promote the establishment of a unified national carbon emissions trading market. Properly adjudicate cases involving key carbon emission industries such as electricity, steel, building materials, and chemicals, as well as key carbon emission sectors such as industry, energy, construction, and transportation, and appropriately apply the relevant national energy conservation and emission reduction laws, administrative regulations, rules, and environmental standards to promote low-carbon development. When adjudicating related cases, distinguish between compliant emissions and emissions that exceed discharge standards, total pollutant control indicators, or pollutant discharge permit requirements, and determine the responsible subjects and the scope of responsibility in accordance with the law.

15. Adjudicate cases related to energy conservation in accordance with the law. Strengthen judicial protection for energy-saving service industries such as contract energy management and contract water conservation, cultivate a mature and standardized contract energy management market, promote energy conservation in key areas such as agricultural, industrial, and urban water conservation renovations, as well as technological and process renovations in mining enterprises. Properly adjudicate intellectual property disputes such as patents and technology transfers in the fields of energy conservation, water conservation, land conservation, material conservation, mineral conservation, harmless treatment and resource utilization of sludge, encourage corporate technological innovation, and promote the development and utilization of clean energy and new energy-saving technologies.

16. Adjudicate cases related to green finance and biodiversity protection in accordance with the law. Deeply study special legal issues concerning the development of green finance such as green taxation, green credit, green bonds, green insurance, and green development funds, study the market trading mechanisms and rules for emission rights, energy use rights, and water use rights, properly adjudicate related cases, and give full play to the important role of financial instruments and market mechanisms in achieving green development and mitigating and adapting to climate change. Properly adjudicate intellectual property disputes involving new plant varieties, biological genetic resources, and genes, and effectively protect biodiversity.

V. Adjudicate Various Types of Environmental Damage Compensation Litigation Cases in Accordance with the Law, and Effectively Safeguard Environmental Public Interests and National Ownership Rights

17. Adjudicate environmental civil public interest litigation cases filed by social organizations in accordance with the law. Promptly accept environmental civil public interest litigation cases that meet the statutory conditions in accordance with the law, and actively construct procedures and supporting mechanisms conducive to the filing of lawsuits by social organizations. Properly handle the relationship between judicial protection and other forms of protection, respect the initial judgment and discretion of administrative agencies, and create favorable conditions for administrative agencies to perform their functions. While respecting the laws of adjudication, appropriately strengthen judicial activism, innovate trial methods and judgment methods, explore special rules such as evidence preservation, advance enforcement, and enforcement supervision that meet the needs, and give full play to the evaluation guidance and policy formation functions of public interest litigation.

18. Adjudicate environmental public interest litigation cases filed by procuratorial agencies in accordance with the law. Adhere to the principle of statutory powers, and promptly accept environmental civil and administrative public interest litigation cases filed by procuratorial agencies on a pilot basis under the authorization decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress in accordance with the law. Actively adapt to the needs of reform, take the Civil Procedure Law and the Administrative Procedure Law as the basic basis, combine the characteristics of public interest litigation filed by procuratorial agencies, innovate and improve specific trial work methods and means within the legal framework. Adhere to the basic rules of due process, ensure the full exercise of litigation rights such as burden of proof and debate in accordance with the law, and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of all parties.

19. Actively explore the trial rules for ecological environmental damage compensation litigation cases filed by provincial governments. In accordance with the "Pilot Plan for the Reform of the Ecological Environmental Damage Compensation System," after being authorized by the State Council, the provincial government in the pilot area may, as the ecological environmental damage compensation claimant within its administrative region, file civil lawsuits against units or individuals that cause ecological environmental damage in violation of laws and regulations. Carefully study the characteristics and patterns of such ecological environmental damage compensation litigation cases filed based on national natural resource ownership, and trial installment payments based on factors such as the subjective fault and business conditions of the compensation obligor, and explore diversified ways of assuming responsibility. The filing of ecological environmental damage compensation litigation by the provincial government in the pilot area does not affect social organizations from filing environmental civil public interest litigation in accordance with the law, nor does it affect the filing of private interest litigation by natural persons, legal persons, and other organizations whose personal and property rights have been damaged. Accurately define the relationship between the three types of litigation based on the same infringement, and coordinate and link up in terms of litigation claims, factual findings, responsibility assumption, and enforcement of judgments.

VI. Construct a Collaborative Adjudication Mechanism to Give Full Play to the Overall Synergy of Environmental and Resource Adjudication

20. Explore the construction of a collaborative adjudication mechanism for environmental and resource cases. Environmental and resource adjudication deals with two categories of cases (environment and resources) and spans three major litigation categories (criminal, civil, and administrative), with a wide range, diverse types, and large numbers. People's courts at all levels must, based on the actual needs of environmental and resource protection and utilization and the characteristics of local cases, actively explore the construction of a collaborative adjudication working mechanism where criminal, civil, administrative, case filing, and enforcement departments both divide their responsibilities and closely cooperate. Scientifically define the division of responsibilities among various trial departments for hearing environmental and resource cases, properly determine the scope of duties of specialized environmental and resource adjudication bodies, give full play to their specialized research, coordination, and guidance roles, and vigorously strengthen mutual cooperation between environmental and resource case filing, trial, and enforcement agencies, and among the three major trials of criminal, civil, and administrative, to form the overall synergy of environmental and resource adjudication.

21. Give full play to the supervisory and preventive functions of environmental and resource administrative adjudication. Fully recognize the important role of administrative adjudication in the rational development and utilization of natural resources and the prevention of environmental pollution and ecological damage. By adjudicating related administrative cases such as the approval of environmental impact assessments for construction projects, supervise administrative agencies to perform their statutory supervision duties in a timely manner in accordance with the law, support administrative agencies in investigating and punishing illegal acts such as evaluating projects before approval or constructing projects before approval in accordance with the law, and prevent the commencement of construction of projects with significant ecological and environmental risks. By adjudicating administrative cases related to information disclosure, protect the public's right to know and right to supervise, increase the public's enthusiasm for participating in environmental protection, and implement the principle of public participation.

22. Give full play to the punitive and educational functions of environmental and resource criminal adjudication. Adhere to the principle of legality, focus on the combination of punishment and prevention, and fully implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity. Strictly punish criminal acts that cause serious consequences or have high subjective malice in destroying the environment and resources in accordance with the law, effectively deter potential polluters, educate the public to consciously protect the ecological environment, and prevent and reduce the occurrence of environmental pollution and ecological damage crimes. Investigate and punish criminal acts such as dereliction of duty and abuse of power by state functionaries in environmental protection supervision activities in accordance with the law, and urge environmental supervisors to actively perform their supervision duties.

23. Give full play to the relief and restoration functions of environmental and resource civil adjudication. Give full play to the preventive and loss reduction functions of behavior preservation and advance enforcement. Adhere to the principles of liability for damage and full compensation, and investigate legal liability for environmental pollution and ecological damage in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate various types of environmental and resource dispute cases, and relieve the personal rights, property rights, and various environmental rights and interests of natural persons, legal persons, and other organizations in accordance with the law. Implement the ecological environment restoration system, explore the application of punitive damages, ensure that the responsible person bears the costs of ecological environment restoration and the loss of ecological environment service functions in accordance with the law, safeguard public environmental interests, and give the people a greater sense of gain.

24. Give full play to the service and guarantee functions of environmental and resource case filing and enforcement. Fully implement the requirements of the case registration system reform, smooth the filing channels, and effectively protect the right to sue. Do a good job of coordination and cooperation with administrative agencies to ensure that the administrative and civil responsibilities to be borne by the person subjected to enforcement are implemented. Follow the requirements of restorative justice, actively explore the assumption of ecological environment restoration responsibilities in forms such as time-limited performance, labor service in lieu of compensation, and third-party governance. Examine non-litigation administrative cases related to environmental and resources in accordance with the law, and promptly issue enforcement rulings for those meeting the statutory conditions. Give full play to the deterrent role of the enforcement linkage mechanism, and improve the disciplinary mechanism for dishonest judgment debtors in environmental and resource cases.

VII. Strengthen Organizational Guarantee Measures, and Continuously Improve the Judicial Credibility of the People's Courts

25. Strengthen organizational leadership and supervisory guidance. People's courts at all levels shall earnestly strengthen the organizational leadership and supervisory guidance over environmental resources adjudication, plan carefully, and arrange thoroughly. For public interest litigation cases, group cases, and new types of cases that attract high social attention and involve difficulties in the application of law, information communication shall be enhanced to ensure lawful and proper adjudication. Accelerate the development and construction of a national information collection and analysis system for environmental resources cases in courts, fully utilize information technologies such as big data and cloud computing to deeply mine and release the advantages of massive case data and resources, and provide strong technical support for strengthening supervisory guidance, unifying adjudication standards, and improving judicial credibility.

26. Strengthen the construction of the adjudication system and mechanisms. In accordance with the requirements of adjudication specialization and internal institutional reform, and based on local socio-economic development, ecological and environmental protection needs, as well as the number and characteristics of cases and other actual circumstances, explore the establishment of specialized institutions, clarify the division of responsibilities, and build a professional adjudication team that is proficient in both law and environmental knowledge. For environmental public interest litigation and cases involving cross-administrative-regional pollution and ecological damage, explore the implementation of centralized jurisdiction across administrative divisions. Explore the adoption of a "two-in-one" or "three-in-one" centralized trial model, where environmental resources civil, administrative, and even criminal cases are tried by a single adjudicative body. Actively innovate adjudication and enforcement methods, and explore the establishment of special procedural rules that meet the needs of ecological and environmental protection. Fully leverage the role of the environmental resources adjudication think tank, adhere to a problem-oriented approach, emphasize the integration of theory and practice, and continuously innovate and develop the theory of environmental resources adjudication.

27. Strengthen judicial transparency and international exchanges and cooperation. Improve measures for judicial convenience and judicial assistance, carry out circuit trials, and meet the diverse needs of the people for environmental resources justice. Invite deputies to the People's Congress, members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the public, and the news media to observe the trials of major cases, and increase the online disclosure of adjudicative documents. Make full use of new media and self-media to promptly release major judicial information, and regularly publish white papers on environmental resources adjudication. Focusing on the national "Belt and Road" initiative, free trade zone construction, and climate change response, conduct in-depth research on judicial measures and adjudication rules to ensure the implementation of international environmental conventions and safeguard national environmental interests and ecological security. Continuously expand international exchange methods and cooperation channels, rely on information technology to promote information sharing, strengthen research on international environmental law and comparative environmental law, and exchange environmental resources judicial cases, showcasing the achievements of China's environmental protection and environmental justice.

May 26, 2016
